name: @bridgingx/tenant-db
description: Shared tenant-isolation mechanism for BridgingX products: registry contract, throw-on-unclassified enforcement, scoped-query wrapper, tenant-context types. Contract, not content — each product supplies its own schema and TENANT_SCOPED_TABLES at its own call site (DR-2026-08-31-01; Bridge Matters ADR D13).
